description: Fetch one TikTok video by URL or id: video_description, username, create_time, duration, the counts, the sound and whether duets and stitches are allowed. Give exactly one of `url` or `id`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The video URL, `https://www.tiktok.com/@…/video/…`. A short `vm.tiktok.com` link is not read: open it, and copy the address it leads to.

name: get_tiktok_video
title: Get one TikTok video
